proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access target restriction
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can represent an item granting at-will spell access, but it cannot constrain that granted casting to self-target only. Encoding this as plain at-will spell access would falsely allow casting Jump on other creatures.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this ring, you can cast Jump from it, but can target only yourself when you do so.

notes: Top-level fit is still MagicItemRecord with passive mechanics; the missing piece is a target-restriction variant on granted spell access. No content or trace file was authored to avoid a dishonest encoding.
